Item acceptance fixes for **0.9.3**: texture/preview attach from a run root, preview follows texture selection, detach, docs, and tests.

### Changes
- **`src/item.ts`** — Per-take attach helpers (`buildAttachEntriesForTextureUvRun`, `resolveTakeFolderPaths`), `selectTextureTake` / `stepIsDone` / `previewSatisfiedForSelectedTexture`, `detachEntry`, CLI `detach`; TS fix on `files` typing.
- **`server.ts`** — `discoverTextureTakeFolders` (probe `take-1`…`take-8` via host); attach expands texture/preview runs to multiple entries; CLI + `image_studio_item` **detach**.
- **`tests/item-fixes.test.ts`** — Acceptance scenarios from the contract.
- **`tests/item-cli.test.ts`** — `detach` CLI parsing.
- **`skills/image-studio/references/model-textures.md`** — Detach in the table + troubleshooting (wrong root attach → detach + select).
- **`package.json`** — **0.9.3**.

### Changed paths
`src/item.ts`, `src/item-server.ts` (unchanged re-exports), `server.ts`, `tests/item-fixes.test.ts`, `tests/item-cli.test.ts`, `skills/image-studio/references/model-textures.md`, `package.json`
